import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    
    freq = {}
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd:
            cost = abs(a[i + 1] - a[i])
            freq[cost] = freq.get(cost, 0) + 1
    
    total_sum = 0
    taken = 0
    ans = 0
    for cost in sorted(freq):
        count = freq[cost]
        for _ in range(count):
            total_sum += cost
            taken += 1
            if total_sum <= b:
                ans = taken
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
